beehiiv.name: beehiiv
beehiiv.paid: Lite: $49/mo equivalent billed yearly ($588/year) or $59 month-to-month at 1,000 subscribers
beehiiv.strength: Best when the newsletter itself is the product or a core media/audience channel.

kit.name: Kit
kit.paid: Creator: $33/mo equivalent billed yearly ($390/year) or about $39 month-to-month at 1,000 subscribers
kit.strength: Best when email sells courses, coaching, digital products or services through automations.

mailerlite.name: MailerLite
mailerlite.free: $0 · up to 250 active subscribers · 2,500 emails every 30 days
mailerlite.paid: Comfort starts at $12/mo; Power starts at $25/mo. Paid pricing varies by subscriber tier.
mailerlite.strength: Best when low starting cost and general email-marketing functionality matter more than publisher-specific monetization.
